User.title: User
User.description: Represents an authenticated user within the ContaHub system, with specific profiles and permissions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

fullName.description: The full name of the user.

emailGmail.description: The user's Gmail address, used for login and identification.

department.description: The department to which the user belongs, if applicable.

status.description: The current operational status of the user account (e.g., 'Active', 'Inactive').

createdBy.description: Reference to the User who created this user account. (Relationship: User 1:N User)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

Client.title: Client
Client.description: Represents a client company or individual managed by the accounting office, including their essential registration and contact details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Client entity.

corporateName.description: The client's full corporate name (Razão Social).

cnpj.description: The client's CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica) number.

cpf.description: The client's CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas) number, primarily for Pessoa Física clients.

stateRegistration.description: The client's State Registration (Inscrição Estadual) number.

municipalRegistration.description: The client's Municipal Registration (Inscrição Municipal) number.

taxRegime.description: The client's tax regime (e.g., 'MEI', 'Simples Nacional', 'Lucro Presumido', 'Lucro Real', 'Produtor Rural', 'Pessoa Física', 'Outros').

mainCnae.description: The client's primary CNAE (Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas) code.

openingDate.description: The date when the client's company was officially opened.

companyResponsibleName.description: The name of the primary contact person or legal representative at the client company.

accountingResponsibleId.description: Reference to the User (Contador/Gestor) who is the primary accounting responsible for this client. (Relationship: User 1:N Client)

honoraryDueDateDay.description: The day of the month (1-31) when the client's honorary payment is typically due.

honoraryValue.description: The agreed value of the monthly honorary payment in Brazilian Real (BRL).

status.description: The current operational status of the client (e.g., 'Active', 'Inactive').

notes.description: General observations or specific notes about the client.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the client record was created in the system.

Process.title: Process
Process.description: Represents a fiscal or internal process/task for a client, encompassing its details, deadlines, and responsibilities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Process entity.

clientId.description: Reference to the Client associated with this process. (Relationship: Client 1:N Process)

title.description: A concise title or name for the process.

type.description: The category or type of the process (e.g., 'Obrigação Fiscal', 'Tarefa Interna', 'Certidão').

description.description: A detailed description of the process, including necessary steps or context.

competence.description: The competence month and year this process refers to, in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format (representing the 1st day of the month).

dueDate.description: The official deadline for completing this process.

targetDate.description: An internal target deadline, typically set before the official due date to ensure timely completion.

responsibleId.description: Reference to the User who is primarily responsible for executing this process. (Relationship: User 1:N Process)

department.description: The department within the accounting office responsible for this process.

priority.description: The priority level of the process (e.g., 'Baixa', 'Média', 'Alta', 'Urgente').

status.description: The current status of the process (e.g., 'A Fazer', 'Em Progresso', 'Concluído', 'Em Multa', 'Dispensado').

generatesFine.description: Indicates whether late completion of this process results in a financial fine or penalty.

recurrence.description: The recurrence pattern for this process (e.g., 'Nenhuma', 'Mensal', 'Trimestral', 'Anual').

tags.description: A list of descriptive tags or labels associated with the process (e.g., 'Pessoal', 'Fiscal', 'eSocial', 'Urgente', 'FGTS').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the process record was initially created.

completedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the process was marked as completed.

ProcessChecklistItem.title: ProcessChecklistItem
ProcessChecklistItem.description: Represents a single item within a process's checklist, detailing its description, responsibility, and completion status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProcessChecklistItem entity.

processId.description: Reference to the Process this checklist item belongs to. (Relationship: Process 1:N ProcessChecklistItem)

itemDescription.description: The description or task of the checklist item.

responsibleId.description: Reference to the User responsible for completing this specific checklist item. (Relationship: User 1:N ProcessChecklistItem)

dueDate.description: The due date for this specific checklist item.

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether this checklist item has been completed.

completedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the checklist item was completed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the checklist item was created.

Certificate.title: Certificate
Certificate.description: Represents a client's negative certificate (e.g., CND Federal, FGTS) and its validity status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Certificate entity.

clientId.description: Reference to the Client to whom this certificate belongs. (Relationship: Client 1:N Certificate)

certificateType.description: The specific type of negative certificate (e.g., 'CND Federal', 'CND FGTS', 'CNDT Trabalhista').

issueDate.description: The date when the certificate was issued.

validityDate.description: The date until which the certificate is considered valid.

certificateNumber.description: The unique identifying number of the issued certificate.

status.description: The current validity status of the certificate (e.g., 'Válida', 'A Vencer 30d', 'A Vencer 7d', 'Vencida', 'Não emitida').

filePdfUrl.description: The URL or path to the stored PDF file of the certificate.

lastConsultedAt.description: Timestamp of the last automatic or manual consultation performed for this certificate's status.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the certificate record was created in the system.

Honorarium.title: Honorarium
Honorarium.description: Manages accounts receivable for clients, specifically honorary payments, including their value, due date, and payment status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Honorarium entity (Accounts Receivable item).

clientId.description: Reference to the Client to whom this honorarium is billed. (Relationship: Client 1:N Honorarium)

competence.description: The competence month and year this honorarium refers to, in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format (representing the 1st day of the month).

value.description: The value of the honorarium in Brazilian Real (BRL).

dueDate.description: The date when the honorarium payment is due.

paymentDate.description: The actual date when the honorarium was paid.

paymentMethod.description: The method used for the honorarium payment (e.g., 'PIX', 'Boleto', 'Transferência', 'Dinheiro', 'Cartão').

status.description: The current status of the honorarium (e.g., 'Pendente', 'Pago', 'Vencido', 'Cancelado').

notes.description: Observations or notes regarding the honorarium payment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the honorarium record was created in the system.

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Manages the accounting office's own operational expenses (accounts payable), including their category, value, and payment status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Expense entity (Accounts Payable item).

description.description: A description of the expense item.

value.description: The value of the expense in Brazilian Real (BRL).

dueDate.description: The date when the expense payment is due.

paymentDate.description: The actual date when the expense was paid.

status.description: The current status of the expense (e.g., 'Pendente', 'Pago', 'Vencido', 'Cancelado').

notes.description: Observations or notes regarding the expense.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the expense record was created in the system.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Stores metadata about documents uploaded and linked to specific clients, facilitating organization and retrieval.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Document entity.

clientId.description: Reference to the Client to whom this document belongs. (Relationship: Client 1:N Document)

fileName.description: The original name of the uploaded file.

type.description: The category or type of the document (e.g., 'Certidão', 'Guia', 'Contrato', 'SPED', 'NF-e', 'Folha', 'Outros').

sizeBytes.description: The size of the file in bytes.

storageUrl.description: The URL or path to the stored document file in cloud storage.

competence.description: The competence month and year this document refers to, in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format (representing the 1st day of the month).

uploadedBy.description: Reference to the User who uploaded this document. (Relationship: User 1:N Document)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the document was uploaded to the system.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Manages system-generated alerts and messages for users, keeping them informed of critical events and updates.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Notification entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who is intended to receive this notification. (Relationship: User 1:N Notification)

type.description: The category or nature of the notification (e.g., 'tarefa atrasada', 'certidão vencendo', 'honorário em atraso').

title.description: A brief, attention-grabbing title for the notification.

message.description: The detailed message content of the notification.

isRead.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the user has marked this notification as read.

targetEntityId.description: Optional reference to the ID of the specific entity (e.g., Process, Certificate, Honorarium) that this notification pertains to.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the notification was generated.

ActionHistory.title: ActionHistory
ActionHistory.description: Records all significant user actions within the system for auditing, accountability, and security purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ActionHistory entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who performed the action. (Relationship: User 1:N ActionHistory)

action.description: A description of the action performed (e.g., 'Criou cliente', 'Editou processo', 'Desativou usuário').

affectedTable.description: The name of the data entity (table) that was affected by the action.

recordId.description: The unique identifier of the specific record within the affected entity.

details.description: Additional details about the action, potentially including a JSON representation of changes made.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the action was performed.

DigitalCertificate.title: DigitalCertificate
DigitalCertificate.description: Represents a client's digital certificate, used for various legal and fiscal operations. This entity stores metadata and a reference to the certificate file, but not its password.

id.description: Unique identifier for the DigitalCertificate entity.

clientId.description: Reference to the Client associated with this digital certificate. (Relationship: Client 1:N DigitalCertificate)

alias.description: A user-friendly name or alias for the certificate, e.g., 'Certificado Principal', 'Certificado PJ'.

type.description: The specific type or model of the digital certificate (e.g., 'A1', 'A3', 'e-CPF', 'e-CNPJ').

issuer.description: The Certification Authority (CA) or entity that issued the certificate.

subject.description: The Distinguished Name (DN) of the certificate subject, identifying the owner.

serialNumber.description: The unique serial number assigned to the digital certificate by the issuing authority.

validFrom.description: The date and time when the digital certificate became valid.

validUntil.description: The date and time when the digital certificate will expire.

fileUrl.description: The URL or path to the stored digital certificate file (e.g., PFX, CER file).

status.description: The current validity status of the certificate (e.g., 'Valid', 'Expiring Soon', 'Expired', 'Revoked').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the digital certificate record was created in the system.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure for ContaHub prioritizes Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and consistent Access Modeling to ensure security, scalability, and debuggability. All user authentication relies exclusively on Google OAuth, and user profiles (roles) are stored directly within the `/users/{userId}` documents, adhering to the Database-Based Access Control (DBAC) principle. This allows security rules to evaluate `request.auth.uid` against the user's profile for authorization, eliminating the need for custom claims.

**Authorization Independence via Denormalization:**
This is achieved by denormalizing key authorization fields from parent documents into their subcollection documents. For all client-specific subcollections (e.g., `processes`, `certificates`, `honorariums`, `documents`, `digital_certificates`), the `clientAccountingResponsibleId` and `clientCorporateName` from the parent `/clients/{clientId}` document are copied into each child document. This crucial step eliminates the need for `get()` operations in security rules to check parent document permissions, enabling atomic writes and reads. For `ProcessChecklistItem`, which is nested deeper, the denormalization extends to include `clientId`, `clientAccountingResponsibleId`, `clientCorporateName`, `processResponsibleId`, and `processTitle`.

**Structural Segregation for Homogeneous Security Posture:**
Collections are designed so that all documents within them share the same security requirements. For example, `/users/{userId}/notifications` is a user-private collection, ensuring only the owner can access their notifications. Similarly, `/expenses` is a top-level collection for office-wide expenses, accessible based on general profiles (e.g., Admin/Sócio/Contador read-only), rather than being tied to a specific client.

**Querying for Authorization Purposes (QAPs):**
The denormalization strategy is paramount for enabling secure and efficient `list` operations (QAPs - Query, Append, Put, Delete). Without denormalization, `collectionGroup` queries, which are essential for displaying aggregated data across clients (e.g., an 'Assistente' listing all *their* tasks across all clients, or a 'Contador/Gestor' listing all processes for *their* clients), would be impossible to secure without expensive and insecure `get()` calls in rules. By denormalizing `clientAccountingResponsibleId` (and `responsibleId` for tasks), security rules can directly filter `collectionGroup` queries using `request.auth.uid` matching these denormalized fields, ensuring users only retrieve data they are authorized to see. This allows for powerful queries like `db.collectionGroup('processes').where('responsibleId', '==', request.auth.uid)` for assistants, or `db.collectionGroup('processes').where('clientAccountingResponsibleId', '==', request.auth.uid)` for specific Contador/Gestor access, all while maintaining Authorization Independence. Top-level collections like `/action_history` and `/app_settings` are secured directly by checking the user's profile from `/users/{request.auth.uid}`.
